reasons: Cited text supports the compliant status: 20.1 provides an unqualified Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement or misappropriation claims covering Customer, Affiliates and their personnel, and 20.2 extends it to Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, bodily injury/property damage, unauthorised access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud — matching the preferred position.

Clause 20.4 supplies the standard procedure (prompt notice with material-prejudice qualifier, cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, control of defence, settlement consent protections), and 20.5 gives infringement remedies expressly 'in addition to' the defence obligation, so the remedy list does not displace the indemnity.

Customer's reciprocal indemnity in 20.3 is appropriately narrow (unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorised, plus Customer's violation of Applicable Law) with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination and Vendor instructions.

Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under 21.3, so the Vendor indemnity is not capped — better than the fallback 3x super-cap; no redline or counterparty comment is appropriate, consistent with the absence of both here.
